fusions.name: Measured Gore
fusions.desc: A practised horn thrust that deals 30 damage, always lands as a critical hit, and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Threshing in Step
fusions.desc: Treads a drilled circle, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Lead the Drill
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder and fights with 1 more Power for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Yoke-Worn Habit
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner, and your armour rises by 8%.
